packageRules.description: Group @tauri-apps npm packages (api, cli, plugins) so JS-side versions stay in sync
Group tauri crates (tauri, tauri-build, tauri-plugin-*) so Rust-side versions stay in sync
Automerge non-major updates and GitHub Actions pin/digest updates once CI passes; majors and lock file maintenance stay manual
Pin GitHub Actions refs to commit SHAs (opens pin PRs for any future unpinned uses; existing SHA pins are kept updated via Renovate digest updates tracking the # tag comment)
